name: Charter Wire
old_description: A Leading Cold Rolled and Formed Steel Manufacturer Since 1936
about:
Charter Wire was founded in 1936 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The company operates as a member of the privately held Charter Manufacturing family of companies, which provides vertical integration across steel production, casting, and recycling through sister operations Charter Steel, Charter Casting, and Niles Iron and Metal Company.

The company specializes in cold rolling and forming, producing engineered shaped wire, cold finished bar, and cold-headed and stamped components. It operates two facilities in Milwaukee, serving as a tier 1 supplier for these product lines, with capabilities in cold heading and stamping alongside its core rolling and forming processes.

Charter Wire serves the automotive, agriculture, construction, consumer, industrial, and oil and gas sectors, supplying components that meet the demands of each industry. Its customer base includes tier 1 automotive suppliers and original equipment manufacturers across these markets.

The company emphasizes its vertical integration with Charter Manufacturing as a key differentiator, enabling best-in-class support, service, and turnaround times. Its core values—trust, teamwork, safety, and continuous improvement—have guided the business across four generations and underpin its approach to customer relationships.
